verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents payouts, payout reconciliation, or itemized transaction or fee reports for Shopify POS. The only related item is a generic pricing-page line mentioning "reporting and analytics". That is an adjacent feature and does not show daily takings can be reconciled against payouts.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can reconcile daily takings against payouts with itemized transaction and fee reports
